answer: Oscillator fingerprinting can cap sybil weight. Each key locks a slashable bond and enrolls the phase-noise signature of one exclusive crystal oscillator, bound to a single pubkey. At unpredictable moments the protocol requests a short timing trace, which must be posted to an audit jetty before the collection tide closes. A trace that matches an already enrolled oscillator, a missed window, or two keys sharing one clock slashes every linked deposit. Fielding N identities requires N distinct, stable oscillators and N bonds, so analog hardware and capital scale with farm size.
